ui.footer_text: SAAF · Three-way Match Audit · Runs locally — files never leave your machine.
ui.upload_subtitle: Upload the purchase order, goods receipt and purchase invoice. The application compares the documents at header and line level and reports — per line — whether they match, warn or fail.
ui.doc_po_desc: The order as issued by procurement (PO).
ui.doc_grn_desc: Packing slip or receipt confirmation from the warehouse.
ui.doc_inv_desc: The invoice received from the supplier.
ui.tol_price_hint_html: Max. deviation on unit price between PO and invoice.
ui.tol_qty_hint_html: Max. deviation on quantity between PO, GRN and invoice.
ui.tol_line_total_hint_html: Max. deviation on line amount between PO and invoice.
ui.tol_total_hint_html: Max. deviation on grand total between PO and invoice.
ui.formats_text_html: CSV and JSON. Column names are flexible — quantity/qty, unit_price/price, line_total/amount are all recognised. See the sample files for the exact structure.

msg.po_missing_number: PO does not contain a purchase order number.
msg.po_ref_grn_differs: PO reference on goods receipt differs: '{grn_po}' vs PO '{po_num}'.
msg.po_ref_inv_differs: PO reference on invoice differs: '{inv_po}' vs PO '{po_num}'.
msg.supplier_inconsistent: Supplier name is not consistent across documents: {names}.
msg.line_missing_po: Line missing on the purchase order.
msg.line_missing_grn: Line missing on the goods receipt.
msg.qty_billed_vs_po: Invoiced quantity differs from PO: {inv_qty} vs {po_qty}.
msg.qty_received_more_po: Received quantity greater than ordered: {grn_qty} vs {po_qty}.
msg.qty_received_less_po: Received quantity less than ordered: {grn_qty} vs {po_qty}.
msg.qty_billed_vs_grn: Invoiced quantity greater than received: {inv_qty} vs {grn_qty}.
